blurb: Left Field is a contemporary art gallery located in Los Osos, a small town on the central coast of California, halfway between Los Angeles and San Francisco. Left Field Gallery started as a small satellite space attached to a shop of the same name in downtown San Luis Obispo. The shop sold an incredible variety of rare and unusual artifacts, art objects, succulents, and designer furniture.
